# Source Packet Template

Use this template before drafting or upgrading an article with significant
historical, technical, legal, regulatory, or numerical claims.

## Topic

- Article title:
- Article slug:
- Collection:
- Prepared by:
- Prepared date:

## Source Map

| Source | Type | Role | Claims it can support | Claims it cannot support |
| ------ | ---- | ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------ |
|        |      |      |                       |                          |

Recommended source roles:

- primary technical record
- regulator or government record
- court or legal record
- academic or peer-reviewed source
- manufacturer technical or archive source
- museum or historical archive source
- specialist journalism for public chronology
- image or media rights source

## Claim Burden

List the claims that need the strongest evidence.

| ----- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ------ |
|       |                  |                  |        |

## Source Balance

Explain whether the source set over-relies on one organization, manufacturer,
country, regulator, or news account.

## Evidence Boundary

State what the source packet can support and what the article must avoid
claiming.

## Draft Structure

Expected sections:

- Definition or summary:

- Variants, tradeoffs, or consequences:
- Source boundary:
- Study next:

## Ready For Draft?

- [ ] At least one strong source supports the core chronology.
- [ ] Technical mechanism claims have technical or regulatory support.
- [ ] Legal or controversy claims distinguish regulator, court, manufacturer,
      and journalism roles.
- [ ] Manufacturer material is not used as independent proof of superiority.
- [ ] Source limitations are clear enough to write an evidence boundary.
